prompt:
An image of a woman standing indoors in a modern, minimalistic room with light wooden flooring and white walls. She is posing confidently in front of a large mirror, holding a smartphone in front of her face with one hand to take a mirror selfie. The background features a tall window with sheer white curtains allowing natural light to softly illuminate the space, and a white chest of drawers with a green leafy plant cascading down one side. 

The woman has straight, dark brown hair parted in the middle, falling naturally past her shoulders. She is wearing a fitted, ribbed cream-colored long-sleeve sweater with a small collar and a subtle V-neck opening. Her high-waisted, slim-fit pants have a small checkered pattern in shades of black, white, and gray, ending just above the ankles with a slight cuff. On her feet, she wears clean white sneakers with laces, adding a casual yet stylish touch to the outfit. 

She accessorizes with a small, structured, light beige handbag with a top handle and a flap closure, which she holds in her free hand. The overall vibe of the image is chic, casual, and effortlessly stylish, with a focus on clean lines, neutral tones, and a comfortable yet polished look.
